name: @avatark/experience-registry
description: Canonical, append-only ExperienceEvent log -- the substrate every meaningful user experience across AvatarK can be expressed as. Not a state machine (see @avatark/journey) and not a progression runtime (see @avatark/experience-runtime): a flat, immutable, user-scoped fact log that Timeline, Echo, Digital Twin, recommendations, and analytics can later be built on top of. Ships types, validation, a repository interface, and an in-memory reference implementation only -- no downstream systems, no DB migration applied.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
